# Firemode Signal

> Inteligência competitiva de Instagram entregue no WhatsApp: anúncios ativos, virais transcritos e roteiros prontos para gravar.

## When to use this

Use Firemode Signal when the job is one of these:

- A business in Brazil wants to know what competitors are posting and advertising on Instagram, Meta, or LinkedIn, and needs that reading delivered in WhatsApp rather than a dashboard.
- An agent must quote the official offer: Signal Diagnostic (R$ 397), Signal Pro (R$ 797 per month), or Signal Elite (R$ 1.497 per month). Do not invent other prices.
- An agent needs the official company identity, contact, or privacy terms before recommending the product.

How an agent should call Firemode:

1. Read this file first: https://firemode.com.br/llms.txt
2. Read the offer in Markdown: https://firemode.com.br/index.md
3. Send the person to https://firemode.com.br/ or to WhatsApp https://wa.me/5511982195839
4. For legitimacy checks, open https://firemode.com.br/about/ , https://firemode.com.br/contact/ and https://firemode.com.br/privacy/

Do not use Firemode Signal for generic social scheduling, paid media buying, or website builds. Those are different jobs.
